decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY adds the Hero V height study but leaves obsolete attributes requiring a right-arm length increase. The source replaces length adjustment with endpoint-height adjustment only.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Kenji,

I think my intended direction became lost in translation. Abstract terminology made it difficult to communicate, and by asking for too many simultaneous changes, I believe we moved a couple of steps away from the desired result.

The attached image is the closest rendering to what I wanted to refine. Rather than changing length while also exploring different terminations, let’s now isolate height and nothing else.

Please create a calibrated progression for both the Hero V and the second V. Because the second V has its own scale, calculate every increase proportionally against the total height of that individual V:

Original Option B as the control
Original Option B with the right endpoint approximately 1% higher
The same treatment at approximately 2% higher
The same treatment at approximately 3% higher

Across all versions, preserve the original Option B slope, terminal shape, taper, and every other aspect of its geometry exactly as shown. Only the right endpoint’s height should move. After we establish the correct percentage, apply that same proportional relationship to the É accent.

Although the distinction is exceptionally small, the relationship between the left and right endpoints could become a defining feature shared by the Hero V, second V, and É accent. It should be almost imperceptible while still distinguishing the form from a more average V.

Thank you for helping me isolate this with such precision.

value_updates.geometry_status: Original Option B remains the control and all Hero V geometry is locked except for a calibrated vertical adjustment of the right endpoint.
value_updates.right_endpoint_adjustment_method: Move only the right endpoint vertically while preserving the original Option B slope, terminal shape, taper, and every other geometric property.
value_updates.endpoint_height_measurement_basis: Calculate each increase proportionally against the total original height of the Hero V.

decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY replacing length adjustment with proportional right-endpoint height options across the three signature forms.

The existing same-message MODIFY correctly locks the Option B terminal but leaves an obsolete length-extension attribute and does not record that the preserved terminal treatment applies across all three signature forms.

decisions.reason: The endpoint-height study does not change the selected kerning, baseline, internal-letter scale, or existing composition hierarchy.
The source changes only the signature forms' endpoint-height study and does not alter the construction, scale, or architectural language of the E and L letterforms.
The geometry study does not change the selected champagne-gold finish, distribution, or material-treatment rules.
The calibrated endpoint-height options implement the existing quiet-elevation direction without changing the broader brand-expression requirement.
The endpoint-height refinement does not change the decision to use a proprietary wordmark without a separate icon or monogram.
